title: Patch vulnerable Workbench Vite development dependencies

preflight.note: Registered after reviewing the lockfile and current GitHub advisories, before changing package versions. Scope is the development toolchain only; runtime dependencies and the Core pin are excluded.

acceptance_criteria.text: Update Vite and the transitive source-map-js resolution to fixed versions compatible with the existing plugin and Node runtime; preserve the exact Core pin and production dependency set.
Run the full and production-only npm audits and record the advisories, resolved versions, dependency paths, and remaining findings.
Run frontend typecheck, frontend tests, production frontend build, generated API type check, and the locked Rust workspace tests after the lockfile update.
Resolve the two newly disclosed moderate @vitest/mocker advisories applicable to Vitest 5.0.0 and rerun clean-install security and regression checks.
